# Warranty and defects

All products have a legal warranty of 2 years from delivery in line with EU consumer law.
If an item is defective, send an email to support with your order number, a description of the defect and photos.
We offer a free repair, a replacement or a refund. Prepaid return labels are provided for warranty cases.
Normal wear (worn-out soles, faded colours after many washes) and damage caused by improper use are not covered.
We reply to warranty claims within 3 working days.
